song_craft: Voice: stotra couplets, one work-voice across fifteen rasa-colors (adbhuta→vīra→śṛṅgāra→ānanda→śānta — the work walks the rasas home to peace). Each verse hammer-tight in L3: L4 = L3 verbatim throughout, music named per verse. Arc: all-containing light (v1) → aloneness (v2) → inseparables (v3) → mirror-bearing (v4) → exact fullness (v5) → play at once (v6) → five-in-one (v7) → criterion (v8) → abiding change (v9) → total inventory (v10) → bondage named (v11) → open doors (v12) → release (v13) → non-difference (v14) → dwelling enjoined (v15).

lines: This god, with this goddess, forever eager for play's delight;
varied makings and unmakings He works at once — the all-pervading.
l4.sanskrit_cite: eṣa devo 'nayā devyā nityaṃ krīḍārasotsukaḥ | vicitrān sṛṣṭisaṃhārān vidhatte yugapad vibhuḥ

verses.craft: Co-occurrence hammered (yugapad unsoftened per UNC); play-delight + all-pervading close.
verses.rejected: (a) alternate-for-at-once → killed by UNC. (b) cutting second at-once → killed: simultaneity doubled is the point.
verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC) / C1 essence / rasa ānanda-vīra of play / L2+L3 voice
